text: In Levin's framework, the size of an agent's cognitive light cone is fixed entirely by the organism's physical body size.
explanation: False. The cognitive light cone is set by the spatial and temporal range of bioelectrical communication and coordination that connects a system's component cells, not by physical size. Levin argues cancer cells shrink their cognitive light cone to the cellular scale by defecting from tissue-level bioelectric coordination, even while remaining physically the same size.
